description: Read-only public tool references, device setup and own-VPS server assistant engineering books for the user's AI; this service cannot operate devices.

setupBook.title: Device setup, phone sharing and router workflow engineering book

service_interface.scope: Isolated Linux loopback MCP SDK, HTTP, book resources, prompt, schema and static reference consistency. This is interface verification, not physical router installation or public production verification.

scope: Isolated Linux IPv4 loopback SOCKS application through Shadowsocks 2022 TCP to a TLS fixture, sing-box 1.14.4.
Wrong-port failure and a single-factor repair; disconnect failure and successful reconnection.
Observed route and server-side test DNS; process cleanup and unchanged host network.

mobile_hotspot.scope: Physical Android/iOS phone selection, Wi-Fi coexistence, hotspot/tethering, downstream DNS/IPv6/UDP, screen-off, thermal and reconnection acceptance. Executable procedures are specified; no hardware result is claimed.

router_hardware.scope: Main book navigation to the merlin workflow; no physical router, install, downstream traffic or recovery execution.

capability_boundaries: This knowledge MCP is read-only; the user's authorized AI operates the actual target device.
The book grants no extra authorization. Respect the active task and required system permissions.
Credentials, subscription URLs, private device details and logs stay local to the target device.
Retrieval is not evidence that a device was configured. Validation metadata states its exact tested scope.
A phone VPN does not by itself prove tethered clients use that VPN; verify downstream traffic separately.
Router package matching is source-backed selection, not tested hardware compatibility; verify actual firmware, ABI and LAN behavior.

serverAssistant.title: 华润服务器助手安装与使用

service_interface.scope: MCP HTTP/tool/resource/prompt parity, assisted recovery metadata and guarded IP-confirmation handoff; no installer, live cloud or actual client claim.

installer_acceptance.scope: Candidate fresh installation, upgrades from 1.0/1.1/previous stable 1.4.0, and unconfigured legacy upgrade passed. Eight protected files plus the complete discovered-provider directory retained bytes, entry types, permissions and ownership. This local evidence does not replace the exact final-commit GitHub publication gate.

network_features.scope: installed-runtime-real-tls-and-xray; local Cloudflare/ACME/Telegram/two-region contracts; no live provider or Telegram claim

assisted_ip_recovery.scope: Twelve installed assisted-recovery checks passed: confirmed manual IPv4, static persistence, DNS readback, next-timer retention, unverified candidate rejection, pending-setup/provider rejection, authoritative-API binding, configuration/Key preservation, and DNS-failure retry retaining the verified new IP. Automatic readiness and daily/pending guards are covered by fault tests. Regional/TLS-WebSocket observations and provider/Cloudflare APIs use fixtures; this does not verify live cloud operations or actual user clients.

provider_live.scope: No real cloud-provider IP allocation or replacement is established for this patch. Prior version fixtures and official-document research are historical evidence, not patch-specific live verification.

capability_boundaries: This knowledge MCP is read-only; the user's authorized AI operates the actual target device.
The book grants no extra authorization. Respect the active task and required system permissions.
Credentials, subscription URLs, private device details and logs stay local to the target device.
Retrieval is not evidence that a device was configured. Validation metadata states its exact tested scope.
Installation and huarun chat run on the user-owned authorized VPS over SSH; the public MCP never receives its credentials.
Server health checks are not proof of actual phone or desktop client connectivity; verify the real client separately.

knowledge_policy.expertise_standard: 顶级服务运维专家，以 CCIE 级网络能力为基础
knowledge_policy.summary: 每轮先查华润 MCP 的文档和排障资料；资料不足再用 DeepSeek 搜索；修复后自动复查服务状态。

automatic_updates.summary: 新安装默认开启自动更新；VPS 每 6 小时检查正式发布的新版本，保留原节点配置、白名单、Key 和聊天记忆。旧版只需 SSH 一次启用，以后自动维护。

proxy_policy.summary: 默认使用 Cloudflare 仅 DNS 解析；选择橙云代理时，区域的 SSL/TLS 必须已是 Full (strict)。助手只核对该设置，不改动整个域名区域的 TLS 模式。

assisted_ip_recovery.summary: 不能自动更换时，Agent 会继续查询厂商官方面板或工单步骤，说明费用和停机影响，保留原域名、节点、白名单和 Key，不要求重装。你完成厂商操作后，把要接纳的新公网入站 IPv4 告诉助手；通过双地区 TLS 与 WebSocket 核验后才同步 DNS，并复查节点通路。资料不足会继续帮你查，不会把未知说成没有 API。

network_maintenance.summary: 使用自己的 Cloudflare 域名和 Full account and zone access 账户令牌，维护 TLS、动态 IP 解析和故障通知；Agent 先查 VPS 厂商官方文档，自动执行条件和故障证据齐全时按授权更换 IP，否则继续协助你按官方步骤处理，再确认新地址、同步 DNS 并复查。

chain_egress.summary: 已有家宽等出口代理时，可接入 SOCKS5 或 HTTP CONNECT 链式 TCP 出口；Agent 按请求切换已配置出口并复查出口 IP，保留白名单，故障时不悄悄直连。

service_interface.scope: Linux ASGI and SDK loopback JSON-RPC/HTTP resource parity, pinned books, no-argument privacy guards and existing device/router regressions. This is not public deployment or embedded-agent installer acceptance.

installer_acceptance.scope: Isolated Debian 12 x86_64 systemd installation, real PicoClaw/DeepSeek with public server-book retrieval and DeepSeek Search fallback, stopped-Xray repair with automatic doctor/status recheck, real Linux SOCKS client, and 1.0.0 to 1.1.0 assistant-only upgrade preserving four network configuration hashes. The new public troubleshooting resource was not yet deployed during the run; candidate ASGI/SDK resource tests passed. Physical phones, ARM and other distributions were not tested.
